expected.position: Applied AI Engineer for Internal Tools
expected.about_role: Build AI-powered systems and agentic workflows that AI& runs on internally. The role works across engineering, finance, operations, data center, and HR to remove friction, automate manual work, deploy agents, integrate AI& models and infrastructure into internal workflows, and make teams more productive.
expected.about_company: AI& is a vertically integrated AI platform from Japan for the global market. The company recently launched with $50M in seed funding and more than $2B in committed infrastructure capital.
expected.responsibilities: Design and build AI-powered internal tools; identify manual, repetitive, or slow internal processes and replace them with agentic AI workflows; integrate AI& models and inference infrastructure into internal tooling; work with every team to assess needs and prioritize high-impact AI interventions; build evaluation frameworks; document tools and run demos or onboarding.
expected.requirements: Production applied AI engineering experience; full-stack competence across backend services, APIs, and simple frontend interfaces; hands-on agentic framework and tool-use experience; cross-functional empathy; bias for impact; great team spirit and clear communication.
expected.notes: Location: Yokohama, Kanagawa; high-impact internal tools role; primary listing does not state salary, remote policy, employment type, or language requirements.
